# This directory holds precomputed data for the AXON LunarSight frontend.
#
# missions.json   — generated by: python pipeline/validate_missions.py
#                   committed to git (needed for static hosting without API)
#
# The following subdirectories are generated by pipeline/build_geometry.py
# and are in .gitignore:
#   timeseries/   — per-site hourly elevation series
#   events/       — rise/set intervals and summary stats
#   summary/      — comparison metrics
#   horizon/      — terrain horizon masks
#   manifest.json — hashes and provenance for all precomputed files
